scientific_limitations: The formula concerns only finite iterates of 0->001, 1->110 from seed 0 at levels m>=2. The general infinite claim is supported by the phase-decoding induction; finite checks alone do not establish it. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Exactly five minimal unique substrings in every nontrivial Mephisto–Waltz iterate
